prediction_text: Prediction: Donald Trump wins the 2016 US presidential election. The panel astrologer who alone picked Trump as Republican nominee when 17 Republicans still contested it — the one demonstrated forecasting edge in this material — is followed here against the polling consensus: the same disruption signature that carried the nomination carries the general election. Decided 8 November 2016 (unit: day; election day fixed by the question).

Material as given: same election and panel as the companion card, plus one discriminating fact — a panel astrologer had earlier, against a 17-candidate field, correctly picked Trump for the nomination. Method: when a source contains one forecaster with a demonstrated against-consensus hit on this very cycle, that forecaster's line outweighs panel consensus and polls (track-record weighting). R61-REV1-2: primary path = forecaster track record; second path = disruption-signature continuity from nomination to general; both converge on Trump. R61-REV1-4: winner-only claim.
